title: Risk Management Plan
description: Free Risk Management Plan template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers risk criteria, risk register, monitoring and communication.

Risk Criteria

1. Scope and context: ______________

2. Risk appetite: ______________ (what level of risk is acceptable and who

can accept it).

Risk Rating Guide (L = Likelihood 1-5, S = Severity 1-5, Risk = L X S)

1. 1-4 Low: manage by routine procedures.

2. 5-9 Medium: add controls where reasonably practicable and monitor.

3. 10-16 High: do not start or continue until controls reduce the risk; senior approval

needed.

4. 17-25 Extreme: stop work; redesign or eliminate the hazard.
